components.name: Offer Headline
components.description: The weight clash: 800 headline dropping into a 300 accent phrase.
components.html: Need a website? I'll build you one at a reasonable price.

narrative.overview: A Swiss page, set rather than decorated. One grotesque family carries everything through a weight clash: a heavy headline drops into a light accent-blue phrase. A narrow rail holds the nav; content hangs from column 4 of a strict 12-column grid. Hairline rules, no cards, no ornament.
keyCharacteristics: One family, contrast by weight (800 against 300)
One accent, only for the price phrase and the Call button
Rail nav in columns 1 to 3, content from column 4
Bands with ink rules, rows with hairlines
2px corners on buttons and inputs only

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent appears only on the price phrase and the Call button.

rules.name: No Colour Alone
rules.body: States are carried by weight and words, never by hue.

rules.name: The Weight Clash Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is weight, never a second family or italics.

rules.name: Flat
rules.body: No shadows or blur; hierarchy is scale, weight and rules.

dos: Keep the accent to the price phrase and the Call button.
Hang every block from column 4 and put band names in the rail.
donts: Don't add cards, shadows, icons, eyebrows or decorative dots.
Don't add a second typeface or italic emphasis.
Don't use em or en dashes in copy.
